# hpe_morpheus_job (Resource)

Manages a Morpheus Job resource.




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the job.

### Optional

- `custom_config` (String) Custom configuration in JSON format.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the job is enabled.
- `schedule_mode` (String) The schedule mode for the job.
- `target_type` (String) The target type for the job.
- `workflow_id` (Number) The workflow ID to associate with the job.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of the job.
